samples.detection_method: Implement strict SPF, DKIM, and DMARC enforcement rejecting emails that fail authentication. Use URL reputation and heuristic analysis to detect homograph and typo-squatted domains. Monitor WAF and web logs for suspicious POST requests carrying credential data. Employ DNS monitoring to detect queries for newly registered, suspicious domains. Conduct regular phishing awareness training and simulations for staff.
